summary: WebRender, Firefox's GPU compositor, received a broad rendering and architecture cleanup focused on using device and raster space consistently, improving clipping, culling, snapping, text, borders, gradients, shadows, and image quality. It also adds CSS corner-shape support, better scaling for glyphs and surfaces, and fixes for effects such as backdrop filters and perspective transforms. Internally, WebRender is moving more graphics access behind a device abstraction instead of exposing raw OpenGL details, while new scene-inspection and wrench debugging tools make compositor problems easier to diagnose.
